versions.content: T he StbM shall calculate the Global Time offset (i.e., difference) between the Received Time and the Synclocal Time upon each, except the very first, valid invocation of StbM_BusSetGlobalTime() . The elements o f the Time Tuples used for calculating the Global Time offset have the following denotation:  TL Sync = Global Time part of the Synclocal Time Tuple  TG Rx = Global Time part of the Received Time Tuple
